# Domain policy binding-query baseline v1

Captured from the OLD implementation on 2026-10-29 before production processing-tape reuse, using independently built, pinned Main and isolated Scope test executables. This is the exact Main v4 producer output, including its provenance. Never regenerate it from a replacement implementation.

`snapshot.json` is 971,166 bytes, SHA256 `9b0a505fff6e88c5f690c68e801b2b5ac4258795f4dd4deb7679b353b71b2505`; `snapshot.sha256` pins the raw bytes. The Main source-manifest SHA256 is `51025c4287c705f3596ba06a047e00752a26efebc638755389ccb9588687c5cb`. Main and Scope complete parsed bodies agreed after removing only top-level `variant` and `source_sha256`. Their common body SHA256 is `c350f4dc0e943f332cd1c59b0d93add0195604ec20454669bfc7eea8fb6acf6c`. No query, work, lookup, event, private field, document or error was normalized.

The matrix has 26 physical Domain/window records and 56 actual policy calls. Seven wide14 Domain parents cover unbound tone, Repeat/default gap, hidden resumed capture, bypass binding, retained reference, fractional Source and selected-placement Source split. Six additional actual owner-input contexts cover exposed Preserve and unity Shift with unrelated bindings, an enclosing Preserve context, an opaque Bound Preserve stage, an ordinary Edit crop with inherited retime, and a checked signed Partition Domain with an unrelated prefix Hold binding. Each parent has a full and empty request; nonempty successful policies also run exact OLD total-policy work and one-short limits. Two selected parents add minimum-work and invalid-span-limit refusals. Seven Root cases are labelled out-of-scope references.

Measured coverage: 24 actual top-level second queries, 18 retained-child second queries, 3 Stage-exposing binding Domain records with an actual top second query, 1 signed binding Domain record with an actual top second query, 2 negative Domain records (full/empty), 2 inherited-retime records, 2 bypass-binding records, 7 first-tape Bound spans and 4 first-tape Stage spans. Successful policy results contain 12 Source entries, 22 authored silent-Hold entries and 16 suppression ranges across limit cases. These counts describe the actual matrix, not distinct unique documents. Synthetic ProjectedStage and general sound Split qualification are outside this evidence.

Every record contains complete first processing(true), a separately invoked processing(false), full policy contents/suppression/work/lookup, exact private Domain seed and complete private Bound/mapping snapshots. The depth-tagged observer records the actual policy second-query Result before accounting and the actual accounting result/before/after remaining budget. Separate false calls are not substituted for policy events. OLD errors expose no partial query receipt, so partial work is explicitly unknown rather than inferred from policy totals. A Leaf/Bound top tape does not certify absence of Preserve inside Bound operands or inherited retimes.

The ordinary `legacy_domain_policy_binding_queries_match_immutable_old_matrix` test reconstructs the actual OLD matrix and compares every field after removing only provenance. The manual `capture_old_policy_binding_baseline_v1` producer remains ignored and requires explicit new `/tmp` output and provenance environment variables. Runtime manifests, executable hashes, failed earlier producer evidence, read-only v1/v2/v3/v4 source snapshots, guarded results and cross-variant equality live in `/tmp/deadpan-policy-binding-reuse-2026-10-29` until archived. This fixture is logical query/accounting evidence, not an allocator or native peak measurement.
